title: Awkward
text: Awkward. Good quality fabric and stitching but awkward when taking food out of oven due the the thumb placement. Actually kind of dangerous.

product_metadata.title: Cosy House Collection 4-Piece Oven Mitt & Pot Holder Set - 500°F Heat Resistant Trivet Cooking Gloves - Flexible, Durable & Comfortable Long-Lasting Silicone - Cooking, Baking & Grilling (Grey)
features: HEAVY-DUTY DURABILITY & MAXIMUM COMFORT – This Oven Mitt & Pot Holder Set is not only heat resistant, but also comfortable, flexible, and offers long-lasting, food-grade safe versatility.

HEAT RESISTANT AND FLAME RETARDANT SILICONE UP TO 500°F– Each piece is crafted with flexible, durable silicone, making them ideal for moving or holding hot pans, plates, utensils, or dishware. They will also spare forearms from burns that can occur when your outdoor grill experiences a flare-up.
TEXTURED, NON-SLIP GRIP – Oven Mitt & Pot Holder both feature textured surfaces to improve your grip strength, control, and stability with hot, heavy, or slick items.

STEAM RESISTANT – Unlike cotton oven mitts and pot holders, our silicone mitts won’t absorb liquids. The silicone portion of the glove is entirely waterproof, preventing steam scalds while cooking on the stovetop or draining hot liquids. You can even use them to retrieve items from hot water.

SATISFACTION GUARANTEED – Shop with confidence! If you don't absolutely love your new Oven Mitt & Pot Holder Set, we offer a 100% Satisfaction Guarantee paired with world-class customer service. Simply contact us with any questions or concerns, and we’ll get back to you within 24 hours.
